title: The Witcher to end on Netflix in 2027 with fifth and final season
text:
The Witcher season 5 will be the final season on Netflix, expected in 2027. The fantasy series, based on Andrzej Sapkowski's novels, concludes its TV run after five seasons.
Netflix's The Witcher will officially end its television run in 2027 with its fifth and final season. The fantasy series, based on Andrzej Sapkowski's novels, debuted on Netflix in 2019 and became an instant hit. Season 5 was expected to release in 2026 but was delayed and is now expected to arrive sometime in 2027.
Production of season 5 ended in October 2025, making a 2027 release highly likely. This fits the schedule of previous seasons, which all had a two-year gap between them. Although an official release date has not been announced, the show was initially included in Netflix's 2026 calendar but was later removed.
At the end of The Witcher season 4, Geralt, played by Liam Hemsworth, made his of Rivia title official while still looking for Ciri, played by Freya Allan. Yennefer, played by Anya Chalotra, formed the Lodge of Sorceresses. Ciri was taken captive by Leo Bonhart, played by Sharlto Copley, after he brutally killed the Rats.
Season 5 is expected to cover some truly dark stories, especially related to Ciri, her escape, and the plans that her father has for her. As such, it has some big challenges to overcome. The show still has two more novels to cover and many loose ends to address and questions to answer, making it one of Netflix's most anticipated releases but also one of the riskiest.
The Witcher has faced controversy and backlash due to unnecessary changes to the source material, especially in season 2. The subsequent seasons did their best to fix them and course-correct. Still, The Witcher season 5 is one of the most anticipated Netflix projects. The show was one of the Netflix original TV shows with the most potential to succeed thanks to the fanbase of the books and video games.
However, the changes made to the characters and stories, particularly Yennefer, completely changed the audience's perception of the show. Still, Netflix's The Witcher has maintained its popularity long enough to make it to its fifth season. The show will see the end of an era in 2027, as while the Netflix show was not the novels' first TV adaptation, it was the first English-language one and reached a much bigger worldwide audience.
2027 will be the end of Netflix's The Witcher, but the franchise will carry on after it. The world of The Witcher comes from Andrzej Sapkowski's novel series of the same name, but what further boosted its popularity and expanded its fanbase was its adaptation to video games. At the time of writing, the video game The Witcher IV is awaiting an official release date, though it is planned for a 2028 release.
What is known about The Witcher IV is that it will focus on Ciri as the playable character rather than Geralt. The Witcher franchise, then, will continue through video games. While at the time of writing there are no more books planned, it would not be surprising if another one was released, more so as the most recent one, Crossroads of Ravens, was published in 2024. As for the franchise's Netflix branch, it could continue through spinoffs, but with the exception of the animated movie Nightmare of the Wolf, these have not succeeded. Even if there were more spinoffs over at Netflix, 2027 will still be the end of an era for The Witcher as it will see the end of the main show.
